terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The agreement between you and EDUWAY
terms.intro: Welcome to EDUWAY. These Terms govern your use of the EDUWAY mobile app, website and related services (the "Service"). By creating an account or using the Service you agree to these Terms. If you are under 18, your parent or legal guardian must review and accept them with you.

accounts.title: 1. Your account
accounts.body:
You register using an active Iraqi mobile number, verified with a one-time code. You must provide accurate information about your name, governorate and school, and keep it up to date.

• One account is for one student only. Accounts may not be shared, sold or transferred.
• You are responsible for all activity on your account and for keeping your verification codes private.
• Tell us immediately at support@eduway.iq if you suspect unauthorised access.

subscriptions.title: 2. Subscriptions & payments
subscriptions.body:
Access to lessons, question banks, exam simulations and the AI tutor depends on the package you choose. Prices are shown in Iraqi Dinar (IQD) before you pay and include any applicable fees.

• Monthly and yearly plans start on the day payment is confirmed and end on the date shown in your Subscription screen.
• Payments are processed by licensed Iraqi payment providers (such as ZainCash, FastPay, Qi Card and AsiaHawala). EDUWAY does not store your full card or wallet credentials.
• Plans do not renew automatically; we will remind you before your access ends.
• Fees are non-refundable once content has been accessed, except where required by Iraqi law or where a technical fault on our side prevented access for more than 72 hours.

devices.title: 3. Single-device playback & sharing
devices.body:
To protect our teachers' work and keep prices affordable, video lessons play on one device at a time.

• Starting a lesson on a new device pauses playback on any other device signed in to your account.
• You can review and sign out devices at any time from Settings → Active sessions.
• Screen recording, re-uploading, or sharing lessons, notes or exam questions in groups or channels is strictly prohibited.
• We may limit or suspend accounts that show patterns of sharing, such as frequent sign-ins from distant locations.

content.title: 4. Content & intellectual property
content.body:
All lessons, videos, summaries, questions, explanations, designs and the EDUWAY name and logo are owned by EDUWAY or its teachers and licensors, and are protected by Iraqi and international copyright law.

Your subscription gives you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the content for your own study during your subscription period. You may not copy, sell, translate, publish or create derivative works from it without our written permission. Notes you write in the app remain yours.

ai.title: 5. AI tutor fair use
ai.body:
The AI tutor helps you understand concepts and practise problems. It is a learning aid, not a replacement for your teachers or official ministry materials.

• Each package includes a monthly allowance of AI questions, shown on your Profile.
• Answers are generated automatically and may occasionally contain mistakes; always check important results against your lessons.
• Do not use the tutor to cheat in official exams, to generate harmful or offensive content, or to submit other people's personal information.
• We may review anonymised conversations to improve answer quality and may limit usage that is automated or abusive.

termination.title: 6. Suspension & termination
termination.body:
You may stop using EDUWAY and request deletion of your account at any time by contacting support.

We may suspend or close an account, without refund of the remaining period, if these Terms are seriously or repeatedly breached — for example account sharing, content piracy, payment fraud or abusive behaviour towards staff or other students. Where reasonable, we will warn you first and give you a chance to respond.

law.title: 7. Governing law
law.body:
These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Iraq. Any dispute will first be handled through our support team in good faith; if it cannot be resolved within 30 days, it will be referred to the competent courts in Baghdad.

We may update these Terms to reflect changes in our service or the law. We will notify you in the app at least 14 days before material changes take effect. Continuing to use EDUWAY after that date means you accept the updated Terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use and protect your data
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us, especially because most EDUWAY students are under 18. This policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, and the choices you have. We collect only what we need to teach you well.

collected.title: 1. Data we collect
collected.body:
• Account details: your name, mobile number, governorate, school and profile photo.
• Learning activity: lessons watched, playback position, quiz and exam answers, scores, mistakes, bookmarks and notes.
• AI tutor messages and any images you choose to upload to it.
• Payment records: package, amount, date and a receipt reference from the payment provider — never your full card or wallet PIN.
• Device information: device model, operating system, app version, approximate location (city level) and sign-in times, used for single-device playback and security.

use.title: 2. How we use your data
use.body:
• To provide your lessons, track your progress and personalise practice to your weak topics.
• To run the AI tutor and improve the accuracy of its answers.
• To process payments and send receipts and renewal reminders.
• To protect accounts, enforce single-device playback and prevent content piracy.
• To send notifications you have enabled, which you can turn off at any time in Settings.

We never sell your personal data and we do not show third-party advertising in the app.

storage.title: 3. Storage & security
storage.body:
Your data is stored on secure, encrypted servers and transmitted over HTTPS. Sign-in tokens are kept in your device's secure storage. Access by EDUWAY staff is limited to people who need it to support you.

We keep your account data while your account is active and for up to 12 months after your last subscription ends, so you can return without losing progress. Payment records are kept for the period required by Iraqi financial regulations.

minors.title: 4. Children, minors & parental consent
minors.body:
EDUWAY is designed for 6th Scientific students, who are usually 16–18 years old. If you are under 18, you should use EDUWAY with the knowledge and consent of a parent or legal guardian, who is responsible for the subscription.

• Parents may request a copy of their child's data, ask for corrections, or ask us to delete the account.
• We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If we learn that we have, we will delete it promptly.
• We never use students' data for advertising or share it with schools or third parties without consent, unless required by law.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.body:
You — or your parent or guardian — can at any time:

• Access the personal data we hold about you and receive a copy.
• Correct inaccurate details from Edit profile or by contacting support.
• Delete your account and associated learning history.
• Withdraw consent for optional notifications.
• Object to a particular use of your data.

We respond to requests within 30 days and may need to verify your identity using your registered mobile number.

contact.title: 6. Contact us
contact.body:
If you have any questions or concerns about this policy or how your data is handled, contact our privacy team:

• Email: privacy@eduway.iq
• Address: EDUWAY, Al-Karrada, Baghdad, Iraq

We may update this policy from time to time and will notify you in the app before significant changes take effect.
